alt: Real ChatGPT /caseStudy execution: fast prompt entry, sending, accelerated generation and normal-speed widget use.
caption: New temporary chat → PDF → shortcut → generation → extended widget use
prompt: /caseStudy Using only the attached chapter, create an interactive case study where Andrea changes training, prompts and retrieved context. Include three written decisions, revealable explanations and progress. Answer in English.
setupPrompt: Use the attached chapter as the only source for the next activity. Please wait for my next request.

actions.label: Write what changes during the training experiment.
Reveal the training explanation for comparison.
Explain the effect of a definition in the prompt.

deliveryNormalization.method: Aspect-preserving Lanczos downsample from 1664x1040 to 1440x900. H.264 CRF14; original 60 fps cadence and duration preserved. Native media retained in the ignored pre-pull review archive.
